description: Elbet wears a burgundy velvet floor-length court gown with a square neckline, gold geometric and floral borders, elbow-length sleeves and a pale brocade skirt inset. An ivory-gold patterned wrap rests along her arms. A loose gold disc belt with a hanging chain, red-stone pendant and earrings complete the outfit. Red-gold shoe tips show under the hem, with one more exposed by the walking opening.
